profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Strives to gain experience in the Cyber Security and Computer Science fields.  Programs constantly on many projects, and competes in national Cyber Defense and Offense competitions.
Always looking to gain experience and knowledge in a constantly evolving field.
Programming strengths are with Lua, Python, C, Java, Golang, and the web languages of HTML, CSS, and Javascript.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Took ownership of transitioning legacy API access control to modern code and OpenAPI specifications. This included creating granular access control policies and implementing act-as token-flows.
Full-stack development of centralized authentication system which included assisting in implementation of MFA for end-users, using Ruby on Rails and ReactJS.
Worked within a micro-service architecture deploying Docker-based containers to AWS ECS. Also implemented Rollbar and NewRelic integrations within the API service and developed an OpenTelemetry solution that allowed creation of metric and error dashboards in NewRelic.
Organized and planned multiple initiatives and directed team-members during the projects. Also provided guidance and direction during onboarding of new developers.
Created documentation and design documents for both internal and external services for the purpose of informing internal developers and support staff.
Recognized for outstanding customer and internal-developer support during incidents by management and other teams.
positions.insights: Ruby, Ruby on Rails and +4 skills

positions.title: Cyber Security Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack development of the customer interface, underlying APIs, and database for the Sensilla IDS using Typescript, React, HTML/SCSS, and Postgresql.
Created and maintained CI/CD pipelines that ran SAST tools and automatically deployed approved features into production environments.
Integrated the Sensilla SIEM with other security offerings and tools developed by Fortinet, Cisco, Sophos, Rubrik, Microsoft, and others.
Lab setup, configuration, and testing to find vulnerabilities and develop solutions to identify them.
Worked in Golang, SQL, and other languages to develop both host-based and network-based sensors for Sensilla IDS.
Performed penetration-tests on proprietary protocols and web-applications for clients and created detailed reports describing findings, risk, and recommended remeditations.
Experience with AWS tools and solutions such as CloudFront, CloudFormation, API Gateway, Lambda, EC2 and ECR, as well as corresponding security measures through identity management and security groups and policies.
Responded to incidents in client networks to pinpoint exploitations used for entry and potential lateral movement, performed remediation, and developed policies to prevent future intrusions.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Undergraduate lab assistant for introductory Computer Science classes.
Lead lab sections when the Graduate teaching assistant was absent.
Encouraged development in students and assisted them in their growth.

honors.title: Winner of Regional in AFA Cyberpatriot - Cyber Defense Competition
honors.description: I was captain of the Wando team that won our region during the 2015-2016 Cyber Patriot Competition.  We  placed 13th in the nation.
honors.issuer: Issued by Air Force Association · Apr 2016

honors.title: Wando Outstanding Engineering Student of the Year for Computer Software Engineering
honors.issuer: Issued by Wando High School · May 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: Created practice environments for students to practice their skills as well as learn new ones. Assisted teams in creating and adjusting their strategies for different competitions.  Student's competed in both local and national cyber-security events.

projects.title: Go-sddlparse
projects.description: A library that allows for parsing and modification of SDDL binary and SDDL strings stored in Active Directory. This package can be used to determine the set access control for Active Directory objects, as well as modify the access control and update the objects.

projects.title: React Column Select
projects.description: React Column Select is a package designed to allow for creation of a multi-select field in the form of two columns. Selecting elements will move them from one side to another. This package is a fork of react-multiselect-two-sides with large api changes.
